en: Nowadays, when talking about artificial
intelligence, we of course typically mean
large language models because ChatGPT
started this entire artificial intelligence
revolution in 2023.
But artificial intelligence is not new.
We've indeed been surrounded and we've been
using artificial intelligence way before
ChatGPT. All these product recommendations
on Amazon, video recommendations on YouTube,
and so on,
that is artificial intelligence. Smart
systems in banks that look for fraud, for
example, in transactions. That was
artificial intelligence. So the concept is
not new.
It is an umbrella term in the end, which
simply describes that we teach computers, or
we try to teach computers, to
think or work like humans, either in
specific areas, or as it's the case with
large language models,
in a broader area, you could say,
so that they get really good at one thing or
really good at multiple things.
And it comprises things like computer vision
so that a computer can, for example, analyze
a video or an image. Of course, also natural
language processing so that a computer can
understand text and all things related to
that.
Now, an AI model like a large language
model, for example, the models powering
ChatGPT, is is not the same thing
as an AI product or system.
For example, if you're using Claude or if
you're using GitHub Copilot or anything like
that, you are interacting with a so-called
AI agent or harness, as it's also called.
And we'll of course dive into all these
terms too.
And these are products built on top of
artificial intelligence,
on top of AI models, on top of the large
language models that are powering them so
that you can combine
intelligence by a computer who can, for
example, make decisions with a surrounding
software that can then, for example, use
tools on your machine, open the browser,
read files, write files, and things like
that.
